text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2019. While Hansen data initially mapped 1.8 ha of tree-cover loss (mainly planted pine), the independent JRC 2020 reference contradicts this, showing no loss in that area. The change was not corroborated, meaning it didn’t meet the criteria for a confirmed event. The loss may have been misclassified or temporary (e.g., harvesting later regrowing). The final assessment status is "contradicted."
